# Wike Declares Self Field Commander for Tinubu in 2027, Mobilises APC, PDP in FCT

[Nigeria](#)  |  3 hours ago

![](https://global.ariseplay.com/amg/www.thisdaylive.com/uploads/Nyesom-Wike-5.jpg "Wike Declares Self Field Commander for Tinubu in 2027, Mobilises APC, PDP in FCT")

Olawale Ajimotokan in Abuja

Minister of the FCT, Nyesom Wike, yesterday, unveiled a cross-party mobilisation strategy involving stakeholders of the All Progressives Congress (APC) and the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP) for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election in 2027.

Wike declared himself at the stakeholders’ meeting of the Rainbow Coalition in Abuja as the coordinator of the president’s re-election campaign in both FCT and Rivers State.

He vowed that political differences would not prevent members of the two parties from working towards a common presidential objective.

The minister said for the FCT,  the coalition had agreed to support Tinubu’s re-election as well as the APC Senatorial and House of Representatives candidates.

“For the presidency, all of us have agreed that it is Bola Ahmed Tinubu. I am going to coordinate the FCT and Rivers State. So you can imagine how important it is.

“I am in charge of the FCT election. I am the commander of field operations as far as the FCT election is concerned.”
